existing_overlap: New term article. ai-term-text-to-video covers video generation as a task and already notes that visual coherence is not a physics simulator; this article links to it and only explains what makes an interactive world model different (each frame responds to the latest action). Reinforcement-learning basics are left to ai-term-reinforcement-learning (same batch). AGI definitions are left to ai-term-agi.
notes: Three usages separated per the assignment: RL environment model (Sutton & Barto definition, Ha & Schmidhuber, Dreamer/DreamerV3), LeCun's JEPA route (2022 position paper plus V-JEPA 2 as one follow-up experiment), and generative interactive environments (Genie paper and Genie 3 official post). The LLM debate cites Othello-GPT (with Nanda et al.'s linear follow-up) and Gurnee & Tegmark for, Vafa et al. against. The robot-vacuum walkthrough is an illustrative example, labelled as such and not tested. Genie 3 frame rate and resolution are public but left out as product specs. Read but cut for length: Genie 2 official post, MuZero arXiv:1911.08265, I-JEPA arXiv:2301.08243. No model scores, prices or AGI timelines. Verify-1 (2026-10-03): independent re-check of all 12 sources; fixed the Dreamer contrast with Ha & Schmidhuber, restored the "or curricula" qualifier on the DreamerV3 Minecraft claim, removed "only" from the LeCun fork example, corrected the Sutton & Barto section label (8.1, not chapter 8), narrowed "developers often" to "some developers" for the AGI framing, and moved the Genie 3 post to its canonical URL. Verify-2 (2026-10-03): Genie prompts are images (photos, sketches or text-to-image output), not raw text (section 4, Figure 10); qualified the Othello-GPT non-linear probe result to the black/white encoding and added Nanda et al.'s linear my/opponent encoding; made the Gurnee & Tegmark datasets explicit and used their own caveat that spatiotemporal maps are not a full world model; Vafa et al.'s Othello gap applies only to the championship-trained model, the synthetic-trained one passes; narrowed the Genie 3 memory line to 'up to about one minute'; removed the OpenAI 'world simulators' sentence and source because openai.com returns 403 and web.archive.org resets every connection today, so no primary copy could be opened. LeCun read from a hash-matched Internet Archive copy. Body trimmed from 2,624 to 2,600.
